_comment: data_dir is the scan output root.
results_dir is where summaries are written.
target_folder selects a specific dated results folder.
plot_dir is the subfolder used for plots and email attachments.
summary_type controls the summary output format.
skip_hidden controls whether hidden files are ignored.
skip_folder_names excludes folders by name anywhere in traversal.
skip_user_prefixes excludes top-level user folders by name prefix.
skip_user_names excludes top-level user folders by exact name.
scan_types lists which scan types to run, each with its own config section below.
